decisions.reason: Photographic contrast overlays and restrained state/surface treatment have specific roles; not gradient headline ornament.
One small product-state symbol is not the hero concept. It remains a minor conventional AI cue, not a claim of originality.
Repeated panel/card CSS names primarily describe one real application workspace; source vocabulary count does not establish a repetitive card-wall composition.

limitations: Scanner signals are reviewed as craft concerns, not an AI authorship detector.
